purpose: Lock the exact architecture boundary, inputs, outputs, and functions for the scalable data-engine migration.

current_state.distributed_backend: not part of the immediate implementation

input.source: uploaded file stream or temporary file
constraints: must not require the complete source dataset in Python RAM

output.dataset_reference: stable reference/descriptor for the stored dataset
output.schema: dataset schema/metadata required by existing application

must_not: own the complete raw dataset as its primary in-memory representation

output.compatibility: must remain consumable by existing downstream insight/visualization code

convert_to_analysis_plan.responsibility: Normalize AI vocabulary into canonical Data Engine vocabulary.

validate_plan.output: None on success; raises ValueError on invalid plan
validate_plan.responsibility: Validate columns, aggregations, filters, limits, visualization, time metadata, and sorting constraints.

execute_plan.responsibility: Apply filters/time handling and execute the plan through the analytical execution layer.

apply_filter.responsibility: Apply a supported filter operation without mutating the source dataset.

apply_time_granularity.responsibility: Apply the selected metadata-authorized time granularity.

input: uploaded file stream or temporary source path

read_result.output: small result representation compatible with existing downstream code

migration_layers.name: baseline
migration_layers.scope: Measure and lock current behavior before implementation.

migration_layers.name: bounded_memory_ingestion
migration_layers.scope: CSV to Parquet without full in-memory buffering.

migration_layers.name: dataset_representation
migration_layers.scope: Remove full DataFrame ownership from the registered dataset.

migration_layers.name: registry_migration
migration_layers.scope: Registry stores descriptors/references rather than raw datasets.

migration_layers.name: duckdb_backend
migration_layers.scope: Execute validated plans against Parquet through DuckDB.

migration_layers.name: plan_execution_migration
migration_layers.scope: Move raw-data filters/time operations to the scalable engine.

migration_layers.name: metadata_profile_quality_migration
migration_layers.scope: Prevent full-data Pandas scans where required.

migration_layers.name: route_integration
migration_layers.scope: Connect existing upload flow to new ingestion/storage path.

migration_layers.name: compatibility_testing
migration_layers.scope: Verify existing API and downstream behavior.

migration_layers.name: scale_benchmarking
migration_layers.scope: Benchmark progressively larger workloads before any distributed-engine decision.

must_preserve: metadata as schema source of truth
existing downstream result compatibility where practical

definition_of_done_for_initial_upgrade: Raw uploaded datasets are not retained as the primary full Pandas DataFrame representation.
CSV ingestion is bounded-memory and produces Parquet.
DuckDB executes validated analytical plans against persistent data.
Normal analytical operations do not require loading the complete source dataset into Pandas.
Performance is benchmarked before making claims about very large datasets.
